title: Protocol
description: An immutable, pre-registered evaluation specification. Pre-registration is meaningless if the protocol is editable prose (ADR-0008).

splits.description: Only chronological splitting is permitted. A shuffled split would let a future minute inform a past one.

uncertainty_estimator.description: Named, because an interval without its estimator is uninterpretable.

exchangeable_unit.description: The unit the uncertainty estimator resamples. Recorded because the row count is not the sample size — flares span many minutes, so minutes are not independent (L-01).

permitted_instruments.description: The set a MethodRelease's declared_instruments must be a subset of. This half of ADR-0011 is what the v1 framework lacked.

requires_bitemporal.description: true: observations with ingest_time = null are excluded and the leakage gate is enforceable by construction. false: they are permitted and the Evaluation records leakage_gate_applied = false (ADR-0022, L-11).

tolerance.description: Absolute agreement required for reproduction class EQUIVALENT — same five inputs, different platform. Zero demands bit-identity and so admits only EXACT (ADR-0021).
